system.description: Whenever you manage to shift the Attitude of a Beast to Indifferent or Friendly, you may treat that creature as a domesticated animal- but for you only (it remains undomesticated in its response to other creatures). Additionally, you may use this Beast as a Mount, as per the Ride skill, provided that it is at least one size category larger than you and has a comfortable place for you to sit.
